text: まえに　すんでた　ひとの　どうぐが　けっこう　おちてるぜ

structure.jp: まえに　すんでた　ひとの　どうぐが
structure.en: items of the people who lived here before

structure.jp: けっこう　おちてるぜ
structure.en: quite a lot are lying around

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: まえに　すんでた　ひと
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing or person describes it. まえに すんでた ひと = 'the people who lived here before'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows an ongoing state; in casual speech the い drops out, giving てた and てる. すんでた = 'were living', and おちてる = 'are lying on the ground'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, cool-guy way of telling someone something. おちてるぜ = 'they're lying around, you know'.
